title: 7 Small-Cap Stocks More Than Doubled In May: Micron Did Only 46%
author: Piero Cingari
description: Seven Russell 2000 small-cap stocks more than doubled in May 2026, significantly outperforming Micron Technology's 46% gain. The rallies were driven by specific catalysts including strong earnings reports, guidance raises, strategic partnerships, and defense contracts. Hyliion Holdings led with a 213.6% gain, followed by Agilon Health at 209.1%, with each company benefiting from positive business developments and analyst upgrades.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Stock surged 213.6% in May driven by strong earnings (revenue up 479% YoY), UL certification clearance for KARNO Power Module, and U.S. Navy selection for power trials on unmanned vessel, demonstrating strong business momentum and defense sector validation.

Stock rallied 209.1% following stronger Q1 profitability, raised full-year 2026 guidance, and Deutsche Bank upgrade to Buy. The gap-up opening and sustained climb through the month indicate strong investor confidence in the senior-care company's trajectory.

Stock gained 184.3% driven by swing to Q1 profitability and multi-year AI infrastructure partnership with AMD. Short covering amplified the move, though subsequent retracement suggests some volatility in sentiment.

Stock rose 161% after Q1 results showed 114% revenue growth and return to profitability, with advertising technology segment up 204%. Management highlighted 2026 political advertising cycle as a tailwind.

Stock gained 132.5% following announcement of highest single revenue month in company history ($21 million in April 2026), though the stock remains down 41% YTD and faces dilution risks from convertible notes.
Stock surged 126.1% on Q1 results showing 54% revenue growth and raised full-year 2026 growth guidance above 40%. Wedbush analyst raised price target to $100, providing strong third-party validation.
Stock rose 117.9% after Q1 net sales grew 59% YoY with over 80% of units running AI algorithms. Positive guidance for Q2 sales indicates continued momentum in ultra-low-power chipmaker segment.

Stock gained 46% in May driven by artificial intelligence memory demand, reaching market value near $850 billion. While outperformed by smaller caps, the gain reflects strong AI-driven semiconductor demand.

Mentioned positively in context of multi-year AI infrastructure partnership with Rackspace announced May 7, contributing to Rackspace's strong performance and demonstrating AMD's strategic positioning in AI infrastructure.

title: Entravision (EVC) Q2 Revenue Jumps 22%
author: Na
description: Entravision Communications reported Q2 2025 revenue of $100.7 million, a 22% year-over-year increase, driven by strong digital advertising technology growth while traditional media segment continues to decline.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Mixed performance with 22% revenue growth and significant improvement in digital advertising segment, offset by continued challenges in traditional media operations and ongoing operating losses

title: Top 4 Tech And Telecom Stocks That May Explode This Month
author: Avi Kapoor
description:
The most oversold stocks in the communication services sector presents an opportunity to buy into undervalued companies.
The RSI is a momentum indicator, which compares a stock's strength on days when prices go up to its strength on days when prices go down. When compared to a stock's price action, it can give traders a better sense of how a stock may perform in the short term. An asset is typically considered oversold when the  RSI is below 30, according to  Benzinga Pro.
